fr.title: Conheça a obra: Green Acres
s: “Green Acres” is an American comedy series that began in 1965, about a rich lawyer from New York, Oliver Wendell Douglas, who decides to leave the city and become a farmer, while his wife, Lisa, misses her sophisticated life.

“Green Acres” é uma série de comédia americana que estreou em 1965, sobre um rico advogado de Nova York, Oliver Wendell Douglas, que decide deixar a cidade e virar fazendeiro, enquanto a esposa, Lisa, sente falta da vida sofisticada.
The humor comes from the contrast between city life and country life.
O humor vem do contraste entre a vida na cidade e a vida no campo.
In the city there is traffic, noise and a long commute, but also many jobs and many activities.
Na cidade há trânsito, barulho e longos deslocamentos, mas também muitos empregos e atividades.
In the country there is more space, silence and fresh air, but fewer services.
No campo há mais espaço, silêncio e ar fresco, mas menos serviços.
To compare, say “City life is faster than country life, but country life is quieter.”
Para comparar, diga “City life is faster than country life, but country life is quieter.”
To state your preference, say “I prefer the countryside because I hate traffic.”
Para dizer sua preferência, diga “I prefer the countryside because I hate traffic.”
Each place has its charm.
Cada lugar tem seu charme.

fr.title: Conheça a obra: The Cherry Orchard
s: “The Cherry Orchard” is a play by the Russian writer Anton Chekhov, first performed in 1904, about an aristocratic family that is about to lose its country estate and its beautiful cherry orchard because of debts.

“O Jardim das Cerejeiras” é uma peça do escritor russo Anton Tchekhov, encenada pela primeira vez em 1904, sobre uma família aristocrática que está prestes a perder sua propriedade rural e seu belo pomar de cerejeiras por causa de dívidas.
A businessman, whose parents were servants on the estate, suggests cutting the trees and building houses for tourists.
Um empresário, cujos pais foram empregados da propriedade, sugere derrubar as árvores e construir casas para turistas.
The play contrasts the old country life with the new life of towns.
A peça contrasta a antiga vida do campo com a nova vida das cidades.
To compare town and country, say “In town there are more shops, whereas in the country there are more fields.”
Para comparar cidade e campo, diga “In town there are more shops, whereas in the country there are more fields.”
To talk about change, use the present perfect: “The town has grown. The farm has disappeared.”
Para falar de mudança, use o present perfect: “The town has grown. The farm has disappeared.”
To express nostalgia, say “I miss the old days.”
Para expressar nostalgia, diga “I miss the old days.”
Change is part of life.
Mudança faz parte da vida.

The dog saves the family from a dishonest vet, and in the end even the father loves him.
O cão salva a família de um veterinário desonesto, e no final até o pai gosta dele.

Buy a bone, a bed and a bowl.

s: “The Good Life” is a British comedy series that began in 1975, about Tom and Barbara Good, a couple who decide to leave their jobs in the suburbs of London and live as self-sufficient farmers in their own garden.

They grow vegetables, keep animals and make their own clothes, while their snobbish neighbors watch in horror.

Sargent repainted the strap, but the scandal hurt his career in France.

“Freakonomics Radio” é um podcast que começou em 2010, baseado no livro “Freakonomics” de Steven Levitt e Stephen Dubner, que usa a economia para explicar fatos surpreendentes do dia a dia.
Each episode presents a question, an argument, examples and results.
Cada episódio apresenta uma pergunta, um argumento, exemplos e resultados.
A good presentation follows the same pattern.
Uma boa apresentação segue o mesmo padrão.
Begin with a question: “Why do people lie?” Then give a proposal: “My theory is that they want to avoid trouble.”
Comece com uma pergunta: “Why do people lie?” Depois dê uma proposta: “My theory is that they want to avoid trouble.”
Support it with an example: “For example, children lie about homework.”
Apoie com um exemplo: “For example, children lie about homework.”
Close with a result: “As a result, honesty is rewarded.”
Feche com um resultado: “As a result, honesty is rewarded.”
Ideas become clear when they have structure.
As ideias ficam claras quando têm estrutura.

s: In Greek mythology, Persephone, the daughter of the goddess of harvest, Demeter, is taken by Hades to the underworld, and her mother searches for her all over the world.
Na mitologia grega, Perséfone, filha da deusa da colheita, Deméter, é levada por Hades ao mundo dos mortos, e a mãe a procura pelo mundo inteiro.
While Demeter is sad, nothing grows on the Earth.
Enquanto Deméter está triste, nada cresce na Terra.
Persephone ate a few pomegranate seeds in the underworld, so she must return there for part of every year, which explains the seasons.
Perséfone comeu algumas sementes de romã no mundo dos mortos, então precisa voltar lá por parte de cada ano, o que explica as estações.
Retell the myth in the past: “Hades took her. Demeter searched. While she was searching, the crops died.”
Reconte o mito no passado: “Hades took her. Demeter searched. While she was searching, the crops died.”
Use the past perfect for what happened before: “She had eaten the seeds, so she had to return.”

Use “used to” for habits: “She used to play in the fields.”

Os mitos explicam o mundo.

fr.title: Conheça a obra: Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time
s: “Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time” is a 2003 video game by Ubisoft, created from an idea by Jordan Mechner, in which a young prince finds a magic dagger that can rewind time.
“Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time” é um videogame de 2003 da Ubisoft, criado a partir de uma ideia de Jordan Mechner, em que um jovem príncipe encontra uma adaga mágica capaz de voltar o tempo.
After his army conquered a palace, the Prince accidentally released the sands that turned people into monsters, and he tried to fix his mistake.
Depois que seu exército conquistou um palácio, o Príncipe liberou sem querer as areias que transformaram as pessoas em monstros, e tentou consertar o erro.
The story is told as a flashback, so it uses many past tenses.
A história é contada em flashback, então usa muitos tempos do passado.
Review: “He was walking in the palace when he found a dagger. He had never seen one like it. Before he used it, the palace had been quiet.”
Revisão: “He was walking in the palace when he found a dagger. He had never seen one like it. Before he used it, the palace had been quiet.”
Use “used to” for habits: “The palace used to be beautiful.”
Use “used to” para hábitos: “The palace used to be beautiful.”
Use “while” and “when” to connect the actions.
Use “while” e “when” para ligar as ações.
If only he could rewind time again.
Se ao menos ele pudesse voltar o tempo de novo.

fr.title: Conheça a obra: Money
s: “Money” is a 1973 song by the British band Pink Floyd, with a famous rhythm in seven beats and the sound of coins and cash registers at the beginning.
“Money” é uma canção de 1973 da banda britânica Pink Floyd, com um famoso ritmo em sete tempos e o som de moedas e caixas registradoras no começo.
The lyrics criticize greed, and say that money is a crime and the root of all evil.
A letra critica a ganância e diz que dinheiro é um crime e a raiz de todo o mal.
English has many idioms about money and prices.
O inglês tem muitos idiomas sobre dinheiro e preços.
Something very expensive “costs an arm and a leg”: “That car cost an arm and a leg.”
Algo muito caro “costs an arm and a leg”: “That car cost an arm and a leg.”
To “break the bank” means to spend all your money, and to “live within your means” means not to spend more than you earn.
“Break the bank” significa gastar todo o seu dinheiro, e “live within your means” significa não gastar mais do que ganha.
“Save for a rainy day” means to keep money for hard times.
“Save for a rainy day” significa guardar dinheiro para tempos difíceis.
Count your cash carefully.
Conte seu dinheiro com cuidado.
